snippet.title: Phantom Squad | Launch Trailer (Official)
snippet.description:
Step into Phantom Squad, out now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841770/Phantom_Squad/

Phantom Squad is an intense 1-4 player tactical top-down shooter combining fast-paced combat with real-time strategy. Assemble your squad, plan your route, choose your loadout and execute. Use a versatile arsenal to tackle brutal missions. Stick to the plan or adapt to survive the chaos.
